text.aria-label: Title text 'Six Primaries with signed-MW readings: deviation from the 7-day baseline, smoothed over 6 hours. Top row: events at the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentile of the G1 leak share. Bottom row: the same for G2 where no recipient is among the 16. Blue: the donor. Orange: the first recipient (top row). Black: the sum (G1 on top, G2 below). Shaded: the labelled event. NGED's event labels are incomplete.'
text.tspan: Six Primaries with signed-MW readings: deviation from the 7-day baseline, smoothed over 6 hours.
Top row: events at the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentile of the G1 leak share. Bottom row: the same for G2 where no recipient is among the 16.
Blue: the donor. Orange: the first recipient (top row). Black: the sum (G1 on top, G2 below). Shaded: the labelled event. NGED's event labels are incomplete.
